      public FileConfiguration getConfig()
      从接口复制的说明: Plugin
      Gets a FileConfiguration for this plugin, read through "config.yml" 获取此插件的 FileConfiguration，通过 "config.yml" 读取

    • getTextResource

      protected final Reader getTextResource(String file)
      Provides a reader for a text file located inside the jar. The behavior of this method adheres to PluginAwareness.Flags.UTF8, or if not defined, uses UTF8 if FileConfiguration.UTF8_OVERRIDE is specified, or system default otherwise. 为 jar 内的一个文本文件提供 reader。此方法的行为遵循 PluginAwareness.Flags.UTF8；若未定义，则在指定了 FileConfiguration.UTF8_OVERRIDE 时使用 UTF8，否则使用系统默认编码。
      参数:
      file - the filename of the resource to load 要加载的资源文件名
      返回:
      null if getResource(String) returns null 若 getResource(String) 返回 null 则为 null
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if file is null 若 file 为 null
      另请参阅:
      • ClassLoader.getResourceAsStream(String)

    • saveDefaultConfig

      public void saveDefaultConfig()
      从接口复制的说明: Plugin
      Saves the raw contents of the default config.yml file to the location retrievable by Plugin.getConfig(). If there is no default config.yml embedded in the plugin, an empty config.yml file is saved. This should fail silently if the config.yml already exists. 将默认 config.yml 文件的原始内容保存到可通过 Plugin.getConfig() 获取的位置。如果插件中没有内嵌默认 config.yml，则会保存一个空的 config.yml 文件。如果 config.yml 已存在，此方法应静默失败。

    • saveResource

      public void saveResource(String resourcePath, boolean replace)
      从接口复制的说明: Plugin
      Saves the raw contents of any resource embedded with a plugin's .jar file assuming it can be found using Plugin.getResource(String). 保存插件 .jar 文件中内嵌的任何资源的原始内容，前提是能够通过 Plugin.getResource(String) 找到它。

      The resource is saved into the plugin's data folder using the same hierarchy as the .jar file (subdirectories are preserved). 该资源会使用与 .jar 文件相同的层级结构保存到插件的数据文件夹中（保留子目录）。

      参数:
      resourcePath - the embedded resource path to look for within the 要在插件 .jar 文件内查找的内嵌资源路径。（无前导斜杠。） plugin's .jar file. (No preceding slash).
      replace - if true, the embedded resource will overwrite the 若为 true，内嵌资源将覆盖现有文件的内容。 contents of an existing file.

      public void onLoad()
      从接口复制的说明: Plugin

    • getPlugin

      public static <T extends JavaPlugin> T getPlugin(Class<T> clazz)
      This method provides fast access to the plugin that has provided the given plugin class, which is usually the plugin that implemented it. 此方法提供对提供了给定插件类的插件的快速访问，通常就是实现该类的插件。

      An exception to this would be if plugin's jar that contained the class does not extend the class, where the intended plugin would have resided in a different jar / classloader. 例外情况是：包含该类的插件 jar 并未扩展该类，此时预期插件位于另一个 jar/类加载器中。

      类型参数:
      T - a class that extends JavaPlugin 一个继承 JavaPlugin 的类
      参数:
      clazz - the class desired 所需的类
      返回:
      the plugin that provides and implements said class 提供并实现该类的插件
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if clazz is null 若 clazz 为 null
      IllegalArgumentException - if clazz does not extend JavaPlugin 若 clazz 未继承 JavaPlugin
      IllegalStateException - if clazz was not provided by a plugin, 若 clazz 不是由插件提供的，例如以 JavaPlugin.getPlugin(JavaPlugin.class) 方式调用时 for example, if called with JavaPlugin.getPlugin(JavaPlugin.class)
      IllegalStateException - if called from the static initializer for 若从给定 JavaPlugin 的静态初始化器中调用 given JavaPlugin
      ClassCastException - if plugin that provided the class does not 若提供该类的插件未扩展该类 extend the class
